lines: Deewana banana hai to deewana bana de
couplets.en: If you would drive me mad, then let me lose myself.

lines: Warna kahin taqdeer tamasha na bana de
couplets.en: Or fate may yet make a spectacle of me.

lines: Ai dekhne walo, mujhe hans hans ke na dekho
couplets.en: You who watch, do not laugh at the sight of me.

lines: Tumko bhi mohabbat kahin mujh sa na bana de
couplets.en: Love may yet leave you as it has left me.

lines: Main dhoondh raha hoon, meri woh shama kahan hai
couplets.en: Where is that flame I have been looking for?

lines: Main dhoondh raha hoon, meri woh shama kahan hai
couplets.en: Where is that flame I have been looking for?

lines: Jo bazm ki har cheez ko parwana bana de
couplets.en: It would draw all in the room like moths to a flame.

lines: Aakhir koi soorat to ho khana-e-dil ki
couplets.en: Let the dwelling of the heart take some shape at last.

lines: Kaaba nahin banta hai to butkhana bana de
couplets.en: If it cannot be a Kaaba, make it a temple of idols.

lines: Behzad, har ik gaam pe ik sajda-e-masti
couplets.en: Behzad, bow in rapture at every step.

lines: Har zarre ko sang-e-dar-e-janana bana de
couplets.en: Make every mote of dust a stone at the beloved's threshold.
